description: bOrientRotationToMovement, RotationRate yaw 180. Box wall pitched 15 degrees (leaning back) at (4800, -600), yaw -20. Input toward (1, -0.3) for 2 s, then (0.2, 1) for 2 s, then (1, 0.1): turns against and along a pitched wall.
notes: t and dt are what the test passed to UWorld::Tick; moveDt is the DeltaSeconds PerformMovement used. substeps lists each CalcVelocity (walk) or NewFallVelocity (fall) sub-step time. Input is the world-space vector passed to AddMovementInput before the tick (scale 1).
